description: This file serves as the main entry point for the DRASim Lua scripting ROS2 node. It initializes the ROS2 system, creates a LuaNode instance that embeds Lua 5.4, and starts spinning to process events, exposing the Delta robot API via ROS2 service calls from Lua scripts.

classes.name: drasim_lua::LuaNode
classes.description: A ROS2 node class that embeds Lua 5.4 and exposes Delta robot API via services.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: The main entrypoint that initializes ROS2, creates and spins the LuaNode, then shuts down ROS2.
